title: [Riso] Monthly Lesson Assignment Report – Timezone – Month Filter Shows Correct Month Based on JST Not UTC
description: TZ-06 — Timezone (JST vs UTC for month context) — If there is a default or auto-selected month, it must reflect the current month in JST. At 2026-06-30T23:30:00+09:00 JST, the month in JST is June; at 2026-07-01T00:30:00+09:00 JST, the month in JST is July. The Month filter must switch at the JST midnight boundary, not the UTC midnight boundary.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org
- Scenario A: session opened at 2026-06-30T23:30:00+09:00 JST (= 2026-06-30T14:30Z)
- Scenario B: session opened at 2026-07-01T00:30:00+09:00 JST (= 2026-06-30T15:30Z)
- Note: Month filter default behavior is pending confirmation (Q6); this TC verifies the boundary behavior assuming a default exists
steps_actions:
1. (Scenario A) At 2026-06-30T23:30:00+09:00 JST, open the report and observe the Month filter or currently loaded month
2. (Scenario B) At 2026-07-01T00:30:00+09:00 JST, open the report and observe the Month filter or currently loaded month
steps_result:
1. (Scenario A) Month context reflects June 2026 (JST date is June 30; UTC date is also June 30 and JST governs)
2. (Scenario B) Month context reflects July 2026 (JST date is July 1; UTC date is still June 30 but JST governs)
steps_data:
1. Scenario A: JST = 2026-06-30T23:30; UTC = 2026-06-30T14:30; expected month = June 2026 (JST)
2. Scenario B: JST = 2026-07-01T00:30; UTC = 2026-06-30T15:30; expected month = July 2026 (JST)
